note: TestRFC2328ReplacedInstanceLeavesSenderRetransmitList queues the old instance for 3.3.3.3, then the newer instance arrives FROM 3.3.3.3 so no flood can overwrite that entry; after install the list is empty for the key and a retransmit tick sends nothing on eth1. A no-op removeFromAllRetransmit turns it red while the older positive stays green. Negative: a duplicate leaves other lists intact (unchanged).
